$comment: Inch-nominal truck tire sizes. Metric (295/75R22.5), passenger (P225/60R16)
and aircraft (H44.5x16.5-21, 1400x530R23) designations encode their own
dimensions and are computed arithmetically by src/core/tires.js — they are
Dimensions are NOMINAL new-tire values in millimeters. See data/SOURCES.md
for the verification status of every entry: values marked confidence
'medium' were reproduced from the standard truck-tire literature but were
NOT checked against a primary Tire and Rim Association yearbook during the
build. Check them before using this app's output in a publication.
A size that is absent is reported by the app as unknown. It is never guessed.

11R22.5.source: Nominal 11.0 in section / 41.5 in overall diameter. This is the reference truck tire of the flexible-pavement literature and the size assumed by the AASHTO 18-kip ESAL dual-wheel idealization; dimensions agree across Michelin, Bridgestone and Goodyear medium-truck data books.
11R22.5.notes: Standard drive/trailer fitment for FHWA classes 5-13.

11R24.5.source: Nominal 11.0 in section / 43.2 in overall diameter; medium-truck tire data books. Not verified against a TRA yearbook in this build.
11R24.5.notes: Common on 24.5 in wheels, otherwise interchangeable with 11R22.5 in service.

12R22.5.source: Nominal 12.0 in section / 42.7 in overall diameter; medium-truck tire data books. Not verified against a TRA yearbook in this build.

10.00R20.source: Tube-type 20 in rim series; medium-truck tire data books. Not verified against a TRA yearbook in this build.
